caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic saucepan with a handle, positioned at an angle so the bowl and part of the handle are visible. The saucepan is rendered in shades of grey and silver, with subtle hints of green and blue used to suggest reflections and shading on the metal surface. The handle is attached at an upward angle and has a hole at its end, possibly for hanging. The background is plain and uncolored, allowing the saucepan to stand out as the only object in the composition. The artist's signature and the year are visible in red ink near the bottom right of the image.
title: Skimmer
